data.name: The Dark Inside Me - Chapter III
data.detailed_description:
The Dark Inside Me - Chapter III: Before the Angels Send Us Back

A next-generation psychological horror adventure game from a horror movie director, built around a dynamic interactive scenario where every decision shapes the journey.

Game Episodes

Episode 1: Her Signs
Episode 2: Sick Minds
Episode 3: Rainy Roads
Episode 4: The Things We Buried
Episode 5: Auschwitz: What Remains
Episode 6: My Sins, Your Faults
Episode 7: Happy Birthday

The Dark Inside Me is a unique 2.5D third-person psychological horror adventure experience that blends cinematic storytelling with dynamic gameplay and emotionally driven choices.

The game is designed to reflect the true nature of the player through difficult moral decisions, psychological pressure, and emotionally intense situations. Every action, dialogue and choice influences the flow of the story and shapes the outcome of the journey.

Built upon a dynamic scenario system, the gameplay changes according to the player’s decisions, puzzle-solving methods, and interactions throughout the game. Puzzles can be solved in multiple ways, and every choice affects future events, characters, and consequences.

The game constantly challenges players with moral dilemmas and psychological conflicts, revealing how far they are willing to push their limits.

Some decisions permanently affect future chapters, relationships, and the emotional state of the characters. Players must face the consequences of every sacrifice they make.

It is said that everyone has angels. One leads us toward the light, while the other drags us into darkness. Throughout life, we make our own choices — and now, you will make them through The Dark Inside Me.

The Dark Inside Me blurs the thin line between madness and reality, darkness and light, love and hatred, forgiveness and vengeance.

You awaken in a hospital room, handcuffed to a bed. Detectives outside speak about a terrifying incident and question how you could still be alive after what happened. One of them says it would have been better if they had found you dead.

You remember almost nothing. To uncover the truth, you must seek for the truth.

At first, the question seems simple: are you guilty or innocent? But this journey goes far beyond guilt. You have been given a chance to confront your past, face your inner demons, and decide how much of yourself you are willing to sacrifice to escape the darkness within.

Gameplay Features

  • Next-generation psychological horror adventure experience

  • Dynamic scenario system shaped by player choices

  • Multiple puzzle-solving paths and consequences

  • Cinematic storytelling with movie-like atmosphere

  • “Play like a game, feel it like a movie” experience

  • 2.5D gameplay with cinematic camera movements and parallax effects

  • Highly detailed rendered environments and animations

  • Fully playable 3D characters

  • Multiple playable main characters throughout the story

  • Emotional cinematic soundtrack that adapts to scene atmosphere

  • Multiple camera angle sequences and cinematic moments

  • Large variety of environments including houses, streets, forests, hospitals, ships, buses, abandoned locations, and more

  • Full HD 1920x1080 visuals

  • Keyboard and mouse character controls

Every choice has consequences.
Every memory hides a truth.
Every soul carries darkness within.

data.short_description: A cinematic psychological horror adventure where your choices shape the story. Solve disturbing mysteries, face your inner demons, and uncover the truth in the final chapter of The Dark Inside Me.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows XP 32 bit SP3
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E4500 @ 2.2GHz or AMD Athlon 64 X2 5600+ @ 2.8 GHz
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 205, AMD Radeon HD 3400 Series with 256 MB+ VRAM, latest OpenGL driver (Shared Memory is not supported)
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c Compatible Sound Card with Latest Drivers
  • Additional Notes: Integrated Video card not recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows Vista SP2, Windows 7 SP1, Windows 8 (32/64 bit versions), Windows 10 (32/64 bit versions), Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E4500 @ 2.2GHz or AMD Athlon 64 X2 5600+ @ 2.8 GHz
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 240 GT or Radeon HD 6570 – 1024 MB (1 gig)
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c Compatible Sound Card with Latest Drivers
  • Additional Notes: Visual C++ Redistributable for Visual Studio required
